expect_state.ps: $f = "$env:LocalAppData\Shamash\missing-features.jsonl"; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { 'no file' } else { $j = Get-Content $f -Encoding UTF8 | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1 | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($j.request -and ((Get-Date) - [datetime]$j.time).TotalMinutes -lt 10) { 'recorded' } else { 'last line has no fresh request' } }
